description: Defines the abstract class rx::TextureImpl and related classes, methods, and structures for texture handling in the ANGLE graphics project.

classes.name: rx::TextureImpl
classes.description: Abstract class for texture implementation, providing interface for texture operations such as image setting, copying, storage, and synchronization.

methods.name: TextureImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing with texture state.

methods.name: ~TextureImpl
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the texture is destroyed.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets image data for the texture.

methods.name: setSubImage
methods.description: Sets a sub-region of the texture image.

methods.name: setCompressedImage
methods.description: Sets compressed image data.

methods.name: setCompressedSubImage
methods.description: Sets a sub-region of compressed image data.

methods.name: copyImage
methods.description: Copies image data from a framebuffer.

methods.name: copySubImage
methods.description: Copies a sub-region of image data.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies texture data from another texture.

methods.name: copySubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-region from another texture.

methods.name: copyCompressedTexture
methods.description: Copies compressed texture data.

methods.name: copy3DTexture
methods.description: Copies 3D texture data.

methods.name: copy3DSubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-region of a 3D texture.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Allocates storage for the texture.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Allocates multisample storage for the texture.

methods.name: setStorageExternalMemory
methods.description: Sets external memory as storage.

methods.name: setImageExternal
methods.description: Sets external image as texture data.

methods.name: setEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Associates an EGL image with the texture.

methods.name: setImageExternal
methods.description: Sets external stream as texture data.

methods.name: generateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps for the texture.

methods.name: setBaseLevel
methods.description: Sets the base mipmap level.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture to a surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the texture from a surface.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the texture.

methods.name: getLevelMemorySize
methods.description: Returns memory size for a specific mipmap level.

methods.name: getNativeID
methods.description: Returns the native graphics API ID.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the texture state with the context.

methods.name: getColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the format used for reading pixels.

methods.name: getColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the type used for reading pixels.

methods.name: getTexImage
methods.description: Retrieves the texture image data.
